newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT, partners to build $100 mln cable.
newsitem.headline: PLDT, partners to build $100 mln cable.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) is seeking partners for a second fiber optic cable project from the Philippines to Guam costing $100 million.

"We have invited all the local authorised international gateway facility operators to join us," PLDT first vice-president Renato Gendrano told reporters. He said PLDT was also open to having international partners.
Kanematsu Corp of Japan has expressed its interest to join PLDT in the cable project, Gendrano said.
He added PLDT had signed a memorandum of understanding with AT&T Corp and Kokusai Denshin Denwa (KDD) of Japan to conduct a feasibility study for the construction of the cable system.
PLDT will meet with potential investors by the second week of October, he said.
The high-capacity fiber optic system will increase PLDT's existing capacity for data transmission by 20 to 50 times for domestic and regional use. It is scheduled to operate by 1999.
